_doc: APEX ENDOFRAME limbs (combat_robot.glb). World after import: Z up (feet -4.82, top 1.69), X lateral, front is -Y. Each part mesh holds both its left and right copy, textured Legs / Torse / Hands; Floor is a display slab. The six rotary barrels per cannon sit around x +-2.49, z -0.48 from y -2.81 to -0.79; the knee is at z -2.62. Leg parts are mirrored pairs, so legs split by the sign of x alone (a 0.5 m inboard margin left inner foot plates on the body, floating as the feet moved). tools/blender/split_regions.py
